newsitem.title: USA: Group lifts Moore Medical stake to 11.7pct.
newsitem.headline: Group lifts Moore Medical stake to 11.7pct.

text.p: A group including Hollybank Investments LP, a Boston investment partnership, and its general partner said Wednesday it has increased its stake in Moore Medical Corp's outstanding common shares to 341,114 shares or 11.7 percent.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said the partnership most recently purchased 172,000 shares between Feb. 5 and April 1 at prices ranging from $8.03 to $9.94 a share.
The group said in the filing that it holds the shares for investment purposes only.
